issue.title: Obsidian Ctrl+Enter deletes a closed timed Pomodoro whose links were all deferred; bob capture x keeps it with its minutes
issue.description:
Found by bob-cli-fl.5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1) and confirmed by the bob-cli-fl land agent. This predates bob-cli-fl. The epic's shared pomodoro_clock vectors only made it visible.

Ctrl+Enter in task-status-cycler and `bob capture x` disagree when a close defers every kept link. That happens when, for example, the only link is a not-started Event Task that gets deferred to the created MEET placeholder.

- **bob:** keeps the closed row with its minutes, `- [x] (**0800-0900** [t:: 60m]) — MEET`. See the vector `close-defers-not-started-off-clock` in tests/fixtures/pomodoro_clock/vectors.json.
- **Plugin:** deletes the closed entry. This follows its documented emptied-Pomodoro rule: bob-plugins docs/task-status-cycler.md says "A Pomodoro close whose children are all deferred `#` links deletes the closed entry instead of leaving it childless", and the code is the `deferredOnlyClose` / `deletedClosedEntry` path. The 60 recorded minutes vanish from the ledger.

The plugin's pomodoro_clock README already documents this as a deliberate difference, and its vector harness asserts only the deferral and the worked verdict.

Since decisions:off-clock-pomodoros-count-apart, recorded session time is meant to survive, whether worked or off the clock. Two writers that disagree about whether a closed session exists make Stats depend on which surface closed it.

Decide which behavior is canonical, which needs Bryan's call:
1. The plugin keeps the closed timed row, matching bob. Drop the special case from the README and assert the full `expected_day`.
2. bob deletes it, and the vector changes.

Then align both engines and docs (bob-plugins docs/task-status-cycler.md; bob-cli docs/capture.md closing section).

task_type_fields.impact: 60 worked (or off-clock) minutes disappear from the ledger and from bob stats whenever the close happens in Obsidian instead of bob capture.
task_type_fields.location: bob-plugins plugins/task-status-cycler/src/060-pomodoro.js deferred-only close (deferredOnlyClose / deletedClosedEntry) vs bob-cli src/native/capture_pomodoro_close/ (keeps the row)
task_type_fields.repro: Daily note: '- [ ] (**0800-0900** [t:: 60m]) — MEET' with only child '[[#^lunch]]', where '- [ ] #task **1000-1030** Lunch #untracked ^lunch' is an Event Task. At 09:00, 'bob capture x' leaves '- [x] (**0800-0900** [t:: 60m]) — MEET' and appends '- [ ] () — MEET' / '[[#^lunch]]' (vector close-defers-not-started-off-clock). Obsidian Ctrl+Enter on the same row deletes the closed entry and carries the link to the placeholder (plugins/task-status-cycler/scripts/fixtures/pomodoro_clock/README.md documents this).

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-fl.5 proposed it and the fl land agent confirmed that the two close engines disagree about whether a closed session survives a deferred-only close, so recorded minutes depend on the surface used.
